narrative.title: The Relay Handoff Streak
narrative.scenario: A logistics relay passes parcels through n stations, and station i only accepts a parcel whose priority tag is strictly higher than the one stamped at the previous stop. The route planner wants the longest possible chain of handoffs for a given tag sequence. Tags can be visited out of physical order — only the relative ranking matters.
narrative.inputFormat: An array nums of n integers.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence of nums.

testCases.explanation: 0, 1, 2, 3 uses both zeros correctly — one per rising step.

hintLevels: Level 1: For every element ask: how long is the best rising chain that ends right here?
Level 2: dp[i] = 1 + max(dp[prev]) over all prev with nums[prev] < nums[i]; answer the table maximum.
Level 3: The patience-sorting trick keeps a sorted list of chain tails and binary-searches each tag for O(n log n).
